body:
PR Summary by Qodo

Add todo add/list CLI with atomic JSON storage ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add python -m todo commands to create and list open items.
>• Persist items in a validated JSON file with atomic saves, symlink support, and preserved
>  permissions.
>• Add 31 tests and record cold-review findings, fixes, and deferred work.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD User["User"] --> Entry["Module entry point"] --> CLI["Add/list CLI"] --> Store["JSON store"] --> File[("todo.json")] CLI --> Output["Command output"] ```
High-Level Assessment

>Keep the standard-library CLI and dedicated JSON store: they fit this milestone without a dependency or broader persistence redesign. Locking concurrent updates is a meaningful future extension, but the project explicitly defers it beyond phase 1.
Files changed (10) +611 / -0

Enhancement (4) +192 / -0
__init__.pyCreate the todo package +1/-0
>Create the todo package > >
>• Adds the package marker and a short package description.
>
> >todo/__init__.py
__main__.pyEnable python -m todo +7/-0
>Enable python -m todo > >
>• Calls the CLI and uses its return value as the process exit status.
>
> >todo/__main__.py
cli.pyImplement add and list commands +78/-0
>Implement add and list commands > >
>• Parses commands, assigns IDs, lists open items in ID order, and reports usage and storage failures with consistent stderr messages.
>
> >todo/cli.py
store.pyAdd validated, atomic JSON persistence +106/-0
>Add validated, atomic JSON persistence > >
>• Loads from TODO_FILE or todo.json, treating a missing file as empty and rejecting malformed data. Saves via a flushed and fsynced temporary file followed by replacement, while preserving symlinks and file permissions.
>
> >todo/store.py
Tests (3) +344 / -0
__init__.pyMake tests importable as a package +0/-0
>Make tests importable as a package > >
>• Adds the package marker used by the unittest discovery command.
>
> >tests/__init__.py
test_cli.pyTest add/list behavior and CLI errors +176/-0
>Test add/list behavior and CLI errors > >
>• Covers item creation, ordered listings, usage and read/write errors, and end-to-end module execution.
>
> >tests/test_cli.py
test_store.pyTest JSON validation and durable saves +168/-0
>Test JSON validation and durable saves > >
>• Covers path selection, malformed data, symlinks, permissions, fsync ordering, and cleanup after failed writes.
>
> >tests/test_store.py
Documentation (3) +75 / -0
DISPOSITIONS.mdRecord cold-review dispositions +11/-0
>Record cold-review dispositions > >
>• Tracks five fixed findings with evidence and four deferred findings with their backlog destinations.
>
> >reviews/cold/M1/DISPOSITIONS.md
round-1.mdDocument first cold-review findings +28/-0
>Document first cold-review findings > >
>• Records initial storage and CLI findings, acceptance-criteria evidence, and the reviewed scope.
>
> >reviews/cold/M1/round-1.md
round-2.mdDocument follow-up review and fix verification +36/-0
>Document follow-up review and fix verification > >
>• Records remaining findings and verifies the earlier fixes against tests and scenarios.
>
> >reviews/cold/M1/round-2.md

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
